name: Murray AI — P3.2 Daily Follow-Up Sender

parameters.content:
# Phase 3.2 — Daily Follow-Up Sender

Runs daily at 8:00 AM PT. Two parallel branches:

**Follow Up 1** (4 days after initial send, no reply, FU1 not yet sent):
- Body: `Hey [first_name] just following up. Happy to send the deck over if that is easier. Would love 15 minutes whenever you are open. Kevon`
- Same subject (replied in original Gmail thread)
- Deck PDF attached
- Mark `Follow Up 1 Sent = true`, `Follow Up 1 Date = today`

**Follow Up 2** (5 days after FU1, no reply, FU2 not yet sent):
- Body: `Hey [first_name] last one from me. Murray launches June 25. Happy to loop back after if timing is off. Kevon`
- Same subject (replied in original Gmail thread)
- NO deck attachment
- Mark `Follow Up 2 Sent = true` and move to `No Response` group

Cap at `DAILY_FOLLOW_UP_LIMIT` (default 10) per branch. 12 min spacing.

## Required env
```
GMAIL_SENDER=kevon@trymurmurai.app
DECK_PDF_URL=/files/Murray_AI_Pre-Seed_Deck.pdf
DAILY_FOLLOW_UP_LIMIT=10
SEND_SPACING_MINUTES=12
FOLLOW_UP_1_WAIT_DAYS=4
FOLLOW_UP_2_WAIT_DAYS=5
```

## Reply-detection short circuit
When Phase 4 detects a reply, it sets BOTH `Follow Up 1 Sent` and `Follow Up 2 Sent` to true. This stops both branches of this workflow from sending to that lead. No additional flag needed.
